game_concept: A action puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Sled Run, a steep sled run: the innkeeper must handle ice wolves while practicing functions. Core idea – Parameter Potion: Pass parameters into a function so one recipe makes many potions.
theme: Snowy Hold – Sled Run: a steep sled run
core_gameplay_loop: In Sled Run, repeat each round: Pass parameters into a function so one recipe makes many potions. Each round, a new ice picks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the potions value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 320 points of ice picks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 320, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 10 (extended tier): Parameter Potion
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Parameter Potion' (Week 6 slot 2), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Sled Run'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how potions changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ice wolves in Sled Run.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 320 within 80 seconds.
